scripts.preview: opennextjs-cloudflare build --config wrangler.jsonc && opennextjs-cloudflare preview --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build:worker && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.test.mjs && npm run check:secrets
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply value-investment --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply value-investment --remote --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: opennextjs-cloudflare build --config wrangler.jsonc && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.upload: opennextjs-cloudflare build --config wrangler.jsonc && opennextjs-cloudflare upload --config wrangler.jsonc
